title: Thank You!!!
text:
What a great tour!  Laura was wonderful - warm, knowledgeable, and eager to share Barcelona with us. It was our first day in the city, and we were completely unfamiliar with it. 

Laura helped us get our bearings, both geographically and historically.   She explained much of the city’s past as well as what is going on now.  We saw everything from Roman walls to interesting places to eat and shop. She also made many suggestions, all of which have helped shape the rest of our visit.  

A great experience, and we highly recommend it!
author: Gayle_T
